title: MissionControlVerdictV1Alpha1
description: Provider-neutral metric, subsystem, and overall launch verdict artifact. Go means fresh valid evidence satisfies a criterion; no-go means fresh valid evidence violates it; unknown means evidence is missing, stale, malformed, errored, or insufficient.

schemaVersion.description: Immutable wire-version identifier, independent of telemetry providers.

generatedAt.description: UTC time at which the deterministic verdict artifact was generated.

evidence.description: Bounded references to raw query artifacts; raw result rows are not copied here.

metrics.description: Metric verdicts. Required and advisory observations remain explicitly distinguished.

subsystems.description: Deterministic subsystem aggregates over their required metric IDs.

overall.description: Overall launch status aggregated only from required subsystems.

verdict.description: Exhaustive status: go satisfies criteria, no-go violates criteria, and unknown lacks sufficient valid fresh evidence.

requirement.description: Whether the check can affect its parent aggregate; advisory checks never affect launch status.

reasonCode.description: Exhaustive machine reason. Metric go uses satisfied; metric no-go uses threshold-violated; metric unknown uses missing, stale, query-error, schema-error, unit-error, or insufficient-evidence. Aggregate reasons describe required-member outcomes.

uri.description: Bounded artifact pointer or durable reference to the raw query result.

digest.description: Content digest that makes the referenced evidence tamper-evident.

unit.description: Canonical unit, which must exactly match the criterion unit.

comparator.description: Comparison operation; range-inclusive includes both minimum and maximum.

unit.description: Canonical unit required for both observations and thresholds.

threshold.description: Finite scalar threshold required by gt, gte, lt, and lte.

minimum.description: Finite inclusive lower bound required by range-inclusive.

maximum.description: Finite inclusive upper bound required by range-inclusive.

start.description: Inclusive start of the observation query window.

end.description: Exclusive end of the observation query window.

displayName.description: Human-readable metric name used by exact facts rendering.

subsystemId.description: Stable identifier of the subsystem that owns this metric.

requirement.description: Explicit required or advisory aggregation role.

evidenceId.description: Reference to one entry in the top-level evidence array.

value.description: Valid normalized observation; malformed and incompatible-unit inputs omit it and fail closed.

criterion.description: Typed threshold and comparator evaluated for this metric.

displayPrecision.description: Number of decimal places used by deterministic facts rendering.

observationWindow.description: Time range represented by the observation.

dataAsOf.description: Source watermark used to calculate freshness.

age.description: Calculated non-negative age at artifact generation.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason consistent with the metric verdict.

unknown.description: Whether a required unknown prevents go; required no-go always yields no-go.

requirement.description: Explicit required or advisory role in overall aggregation.

policy.description: Explicit handling of unknown required metrics.

requiredMetricIds.description: Metric IDs whose verdicts determine this subsystem verdict.

advisoryMetricIds.description: Metric IDs retained for context but excluded from this subsystem verdict.

policy.description: Explicit handling of unknown required subsystems.

requiredSubsystemIds.description: Subsystem IDs whose verdicts determine overall launch status.

advisorySubsystemIds.description: Subsystem IDs retained for context but excluded from overall launch status.

verdict.description: Authoritative overall go, no-go, or unknown status.
